title: Two unrelated NPCs in different, distant regions are both named 'Old Maud' and share an identical dialogue/description template ('doesn't look up first. Looks up eventually, and takes your measure quick'): one in Thornwold's deep wood (Maud's Smoke-Hut) and one implied on Coldpass's Goat Track (Abbot Corvin's bell-clapper quest). A near-identical unnamed template also appears as 'the last keeper' in Marrowgate's Cistern Cell. Reusing the same name for a different character risks momentary confusion about whether it's the same person.
where: Maud's Smoke-Hut (Thornwold) vs. Abbot Corvin's 'Ringing the Bell' quest reference to 'Old Maud, on the Goat Track' (Coldpass)
